Table without thead uses first row as implied header

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<table><tr><td>Product</td><td>Price</td></tr><tr><td>Apple</td><td>1.00</td></tr></table>')
puts result.inspect
```
